units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:6">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>ילפִשְׁעִי</he>, v. <cite ref="O00071"><he>סָבַל</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Vayesheb 4 <he>מה פשעי</he> what wrong have I done?; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּשָׁעִים</he>.
Ib. 36ᵇ פ׳ אלו המרדים by p’shaʿim are meant rebellious acts; Y. ib. III, 40ᵈ bot. פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם; Tosef. ib. II, 1; a. e.
